title: Security asks for your API key
scenario: Someone in a developer chat says a leaked API key is causing abuse and asks you to paste the current key into a “secret scanner” bot so it can verify whether the leak is real.

answers.A: Paste only the last half of the key so the bot can compare it without receiving the full secret.
answers.B: Do not paste the key; rotate/revoke it through the official secrets platform and follow the security incident process.
answers.C: Notify security and check logs/secret-scanning alerts through trusted tools.

explanation: Partial secrets can still aid attacks, and a scanner does not need you to disclose the secret to prove it exists.
proTip: If a secret may be leaked, rotate it—do not redistribute it.
